content.user_title: Evaluate Paid Campaign Changes Against Controls
content.value_statement: Paid campaign changes are difficult to judge when timing, attribution, and controls differ. This skill creates a fixed readback and a clear decision.
actual_capabilities: Defines a fixed readback window after the campaign exits its learning phase.
Compares candidate performance with an unchanged campaign, sibling ad set, holdout, or benchmark.
Normalizes attribution windows, conversion lag, and currency before comparing results.
Delegates ROAS and CPA arithmetic to the referenced ROI calculator.
Classifies results as Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.
Produces a reusable summary with metrics, caveats, decisions, and the next readback date.
limitations: Requires user-provided campaign, analytics, or ecommerce exports.
Does not calculate ROAS or CPA ratios independently.
Does not replace cross-channel performance reporting.
Cannot prove impact without a suitable control and trustworthy conversion tracking.

use_cases.title: Review a budget increase
use_cases.description: Compare a changed campaign with an unchanged control after the learning phase and recommend the next action.

use_cases.title: Assess new creative
use_cases.description: Measure creative performance against a sibling ad set using a fixed window and normalized attribution.

use_cases.title: Validate measurement quality
use_cases.description: Identify broken tracking, duplicated conversions, or incompatible attribution before accepting a ROAS result.

prompt_templates.title: Review one campaign change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my campaign change from [date]. Use [control] and [window], then recommend Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one campaign export and a known control.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creative performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the new creative in [ad set] against [control]. Account for learning phase, conversion lag, attribution window, and currency.
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer needs a controlled creative readback.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize platform results
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Meta and Google exports. Normalize currency and attribution windows, label evidence sources, and flag any unsupported comparison.
prompt_templates.scenario: An analyst has exports from two advertising platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Run an advanced readback
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete readback for [change]. Test measurement integrity, calculate delta versus control, document uncertainty, and set the next readback date.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs a decision record with explicit caveats.

output_examples.input: A budget increase completed learning 14 days ago. ROAS improved 12 percent while the control improved 2 percent.
output_examples.output: Promote. Candidate ROAS gained 10 percentage points versus control. Confirm attribution and tracking integrity before applying the change elsewhere.

output_examples.input: New creative has seven days of data, but the control uses a different attribution window.
output_examples.output: Unproven. Normalize attribution windows and allow conversion lag to mature before making a decision.

output_examples.input: CPA increased beyond the accepted limit while the unchanged control remained stable.
output_examples.output: Rollback. The candidate underperformed the control beyond the stated CPA threshold. Record the result and preserve the control.

best_practices: Choose the control and decision threshold before reviewing results.
Normalize currency, attribution windows, and conversion lag before comparing metrics.
Label every figure as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not judge a change using raw before-and-after totals without a control.
Do not compare platform ROAS values with different attribution windows or currencies.
Do not promote a change when tracking is broken or conversions are duplicated.

faq.question: What data does this skill require?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign change, dates, control, target metric, attribution settings, currency, and relevant exported performance data.

faq.question: Does this skill connect directly to advertising platforms?
faq.answer: No connection is required. It primarily uses manual exports from your own advertising, analytics, and ecommerce accounts.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROAS and CPA?
faq.answer: It delegates ratio arithmetic to the referenced ROI calculator and uses those results for the campaign decision.

faq.question: What happens when no control exists?
faq.answer: The result is marked Unproven because a raw before-and-after comparison cannot establish the change effect.

faq.question: Can it compare Meta and Google campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes, after normalizing currency and attribution windows and accounting for conversion lag.

faq.question: When should a campaign be rolled back?
faq.answer: Rollback is appropriate when the candidate loses to the control beyond the precommitted decision threshold.
